tagline.en: UK MNO — premium coverage; cheap PAYG eSIM exists only via CS chat
tagline.zh: 英国实体运营商——覆盖顶级，便宜Paygo eSIM只在客服渠道

description.en: Vodafone UK is a full MNO with its own network (merged with Three UK). Storefront eSIM plans are expensive; the affordable options — a £10 Pay-as-you-go eSIM and a basic monthly plan — are offered only through customer service, per the 2026-03 review. Keep-alive: any balance change within each 180-day window. No real-name ID required; strong EU roaming coverage.
description.zh: Vodafone英国是拥有自有网络的实体运营商（已与Three合并）。官网在售eSIM套餐偏贵；据2026-03盘点，划算的选项——10英镑Paygo eSIM与基础月付——仅客服渠道提供。保号：每180天内任意一次余额变动。无需实名认证，欧盟漫游覆盖较好。

details.en:
Vodafone UK is the premium tier of this UK roundup: own-network coverage (and post-merger scale with Three), good EU roaming, no real-name ID — but you pay for it unless you haggle. The storefront's eSIM plans run expensive; repeated CS chats in the source review confirmed the cheapest routes are a £10 Pay-as-you-go eSIM and a basic monthly plan, both CS-only, with nothing cheaper available. Free-trial eSIM promos (a 7-day trial announced in May, an expanded free-join pilot in June 2026) were both found dead on arrival when actually attempted.

Keep-alive is the familiar 180-day balance-change rule. Best for high-budget users who need top-tier network stability; cloud residents roaming mainly in China get better value from giffgaff, CTExcel or CMLink.
details.zh:
Vodafone英国是本轮英国盘点的「高配档」：自有网络覆盖（与Three合并后规模更大）、欧盟漫游好、无需实名——但不还价就要多花钱。官网在售eSIM套餐贵；源盘点中多轮客服对话确认，最便宜路径是10英镑Paygo eSIM与基础月付，均仅客服可办，且再无更低价格。免费试用eSIM的促销（2026年5月宣布的7天试用、6月扩大的免费加入试点）在实际尝试时均已失效。

保号是熟悉的180天余额变动规则。最适合预算充足、要顶级网络稳定的用户；以中国漫游为主的云居民，giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink性价比更高。

bestFor.en: High-budget users who prioritise network stability and EU roaming on a full MNO.
bestFor.zh: 预算充足、最看重实体运营商网络稳定性与欧盟漫游的用户。
